• Digital Transformation & Strategy: Partner with Business Directors and stakeholders to reimagine in-house infrastructure and internal applications, transitioning legacy systems to a modular, high-performance React.js CMS block architecture.

  • Lead Developer (Optimizely 12 CMS): Direct the UI/UX strategy for 12+ CMS instances; inherited and modernized a legacy MUI React library to facilitate rapid feature deployment and enterprise scalability.

  • FinTech & Payment Systems: Engineered a custom billing/payment portal integrated with Sensepass (Omnichannel SDK/API), Autopay API middleware, and Retail Realm to secure and streamline multi-channel financial transactions.

  • Cross-Departmental Orchestration: Led the implementation of Optimizely and Dynamics 365 (CE & FNO) integrations across Marketing, Finance, and E-commerce teams to deliver a unified customer-facing web experience.

  • MarTech & Data Analytics: Architected Google Tag Manager (GTM) and Conversions API integrations with partners including Meta, Snapchat, and Wunderkind, optimizing user data tracking across web and email touchpoints.

  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Optimize and debug Docker containers within Kubernetes clusters; collaborated on Azure Service Bus and .NET RESTful API architectures to ensure high availability for live customer environments.

  • Technical Governance: Serve as a Required Pull Request Approver, facilitating code reviews and leading technical refinement meetings. Author spec documentation and direct QA teams on D365 and UI environment testing.

  • Security & Identity: Scaled enterprise identity management through Okta Auth0 and SSO integrations, ensuring secure and seamless authentication across the Vector ecosystem.

  • CRM Enablement: Developed and maintained a standardized HTML5/CSS3 templated email library, enabling the CRM team to execute responsive, high-volume communication strategies.

• Systems Architecture Overhaul: Collaborated with Business Directors and key stakeholders to architect a complete reimagining of legacy in-house applications and infrastructure, successfully migrating to a modular React.js CMS block system.

  • Cross-Functional Implementation: Directed the deployment of Optimizely across Marketing, Finance, and E-commerce departments, bridging the gap between technical requirements and customer-facing web portal functionality.

  • Precision Data Integration: Partnered with global agency partners (Meta, Snapchat, Wunderkind) to implement GTM and Conversions API solutions, optimizing user data tracking across web and email ecosystems for enhanced marketing attribution.

  • CRM Operational Excellence: Established and managed a robust HTML5 & CSS3 template library for the CRM team, significantly reducing production time while ensuring responsive design standards across all email communications.

• Interactive Web Development: Engineered and styled high-traffic interactive web applications for The University at Albany (UAlbany) using Ember.js and SCSS, ensuring a responsive and accessible user experience.

  • FinTech & CMS Integration: Architected and integrated a secure Drupal CMS payment portal, leveraging a combination of proprietary and third-party APIs to facilitate seamless financial transactions.

  • Metric Ecosystem Architecture: Strategized and implemented third-party tracking architectures—including Facebook Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and Google Analytics—to provide clients with deep data visibility and performance metrics.

• Full-Stack Feature Engineering: Developed and optimized core features for the Albany Med Routefinder Android web application, utilizing a robust frontend stack including ES6, Handlebars, Backbone.js, and Marionette.

  • Cloud & Geospatial Infrastructure: Architected and implemented scalable solutions for Amazon Web Services (AWS) integrations and optimized application logic for high-frequency Google Maps API communication.

  • UX/UI Standardization: Collaborated with cross-functional design and development teams to ensure a high-performance, consistent user experience across the AMC ecosystem, including public-facing websites and secure CMS payment portals.
